definitions.evaluable_gain: dimension not evaluable under the original rule (B_d None or th1 None) but evaluable and positive under the calibrated rule
definitions.recentering: raw statistic T_d exceeds the original per-cell threshold th1, but the original centered statistic T_d - B_d does not: the -B_d re-centering suppressed it under orig
definitions.pooling: T_d > th2 while T_d <= th1: the family-pooled q98 threshold is LOWER than the per-cell max-of-3 threshold on this dimension -> pooling enabled it

note: Removals: on every orig-fired dim of a removed row, T_d > th1 holds (B_d >= 0), so each removed union positive still fires the V_thr_only variant (raw statistic, original per-cell thresholds); removals are attributable to the threshold/pooling axis alone. New positives: OR over the per-dimension mechanisms above; a row can carry multiple (reported as combined).
